SELECT   c.first_name,   c.last_name,   COUNT(r.rental_id) FROM customer AS c JOIN rental AS r   ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY   c.first_name,   c.last_name ORDER BY   COUNT(r.rental_id) DESC LIMIT 5
